description: Inspect a public GitHub repository via read-only static Tree-sitter AST analysis (<= 100MB source archive, strictly read-only) to retrieve its AI Hangover Score (0-100), complexity hotspots, and Day-0 baseline preview. Example: repo='go-chi/chi' returns the AST scorecard for go-chi/chi. Use when auditing a public GitHub owner/repo URL. Do NOT use when checking private repositories (private codebases require local CLI inspection via @mgantlett/nomos).

repo.description: Public GitHub owner/repo slug or full https://github.com/<owner>/<repo> URL.

name: xray_github_repo

canonicalUrl.description: Canonical documentation or twin URL for citation.

hangoverScore.description: Composite 0-100 AI Hangover structural debt score.

title: Inspect Public GitHub Repo AST X-Ray
